method.advance: At least two useful added works across both generators within a held split, zero lost previous locations by union and at most one additional ordinary work group in that split; replicate benefit with no excess alarm on the other split before production. Independently report existing native app layout eligibility.
method.coverage: Require one complete tokenizer window. Bind the target and both adjacent source sentence slices and their exact context hashes on both sides; only one sentence may differ. Count useful at >=.30 nonwhite IoU and >=.50 recall.
method.held: Two independent held splits: 21 native Wellcome/Gates work pairs and their 32 rewrites (Qwen, SmolLM2), plus 10 F1000 work pairs and 14 rewrites (Granite, OLMo). Exact inputs not shared with selection. Sources have prior project exposure.
method.scores: Compare model-specific native exact earlier/later log-odds changes on the target sentence alone and its matching three-sentence context. Primary candidate is the minimum across both scales and both models. Compare center-only minimum, original fixed paired context rule, and current first six native windows.
method.selection: Set the two additional cutoffs at the second-highest genuine work maximum on nine dated F1000 pairs. No AI edit labels enter cutoffs.
